job.desc_police: Maintain law and order in the city. Officers earn from illegal activity fines.
job.info_police:
• **Overtime**: 40% chance for +1500 coins on `work`.
• **Crime Sweep**: +50% bonus when catching criminals in the `crime` command.
• **Deterrence**: Double the fine for others if they fail a `rob` attempt where you are.
job.desc_criminal: Live life on the edge. High risks, high rewards, and a constant game of cat and mouse.
job.info_criminal:
• **Master Thief**: +15% success rate on `rob` and `crime` commands.
• **Escape Artist**: 50% chance to pay a much lower fine when caught (with gear).
• **High Stakes**: +50% bonus when successfully robbing Police Headquarters.
job.desc_doctor: Save lives and study the human body. Earn from the misfortunes of others.
job.info_doctor:
• **Treatment Fees**: Earn coins whenever someone fails a `slut` attempt.
• **Medical Grant**: 30% chance for +100-300 coins on `daily` rewards.
• **First Aid**: Passive +5% income bonus from all sources.
job.desc_programmer: Build the future with code. High efficiency and guaranteed income.
job.info_programmer:
• **Code Optimization**: Flat +2500 coins bonus on every `work` command.
• **Regex Master**: Reveals extra special character hints in `scramble` game.
• **High Focus**: +30% bonus in Word Chain & Scramble brain games.
job.desc_farmer: Connect with the earth. Hard work leads to bountiful harvests.
job.info_farmer:
• **Bumper Crop**: 25% chance for x2.5 rewards on `work`.
• **Master Angler**: Highest chance to catch Super Rare/Mythical fish.
• **Thrift**: 10% chance to not consume bait while fishing.
job.desc_hacker: Data is the new gold. Exploit systems for gain.
job.info_hacker:
• **System Breach**: 35% chance for x2 rewards on the `search` command.
• **Minesweeper**: Automatically flags one mine correctly at the start.
• **Data Leak**: 15% chance to find valuable files for +200-500 coins on `search`.
job.desc_streamer: Build your audience and go viral. High potential for massive hype.
job.info_streamer:
• **Viral Content**: 25% chance for x5 rewards on `work` command.
• **Subathon**: 50% chance for +200% `daily` reward bonus.
• **Sub Hype**: 20% chance for double winnings in slot machines.
job.desc_chef: Cook up a storm. Precision in the kitchen leads to tips and fame.
job.info_chef:
• **Michelin Star**: 50% chance to triple the `daily` reward.
• **VIP Menu**: 20% chance for x2 rewards on `work` command.
• **Tips**: Receive 50-100 coins on a Blackjack Push (Tie).
job.desc_musician: Let the rhythm guide you. Find your flow and double your luck.
job.info_musician:
• **Flow State**: 20% chance to double rewards in `rps` and `gamble`.
• **Performance**: +20% coins in active interaction games.
• **Rhythm**: Slight reduction in game interaction cooldowns.
job.desc_soldier: Serve and protect. Disciplined training provides guaranteed bonuses.
job.info_soldier:
• **Iron Discipline**: Guaranteed +2000 coins salary bonus on every `work` command.
• **Armed**: -30% lower fines for failed `crime` attempts.
• **Advance**: +10% higher `rob` success rate.
job.desc_trader: Buy low, sell high. Master the market to minimize losses.
job.info_trader:
• **Loss Insurance**: 35% chance for 50% refund on `rps` loss / 25% `coinflip`.
• **Market Tip**: Flat +150 coins on every `search` command.
• **Manipulation**: +10% higher winning odds in slot machines.
job.desc_teacher: Shape the next generation. Knowledge is power and multiplier.
job.info_teacher:
• **Academic**: Permanent 1.5x XP multiplier for all bot actions.
• **Tutoring**: In `trivia`, all other participants get +50% coins and +10 XP.
• **Demerit**: Heavier penalties and risk of demotion on failed `rob` or `crime`.
job.chef_tip: 👨‍🍳 **Chef's Tip!** The dealer tips you {{amount}} coins for your precision! 🍳
job.fact_police: Police Officers can receive extra fines from caught criminals!
job.fact_criminal: Master thieves have higher success rates and pay lower fines when equipped.
job.fact_doctor: Doctors earn passive income from citizens who unfortunately end up hospitalized.
job.fact_programmer: Programmers skilled in Regex get extra hints in the Scramble game!
job.fact_farmer: Farmers are the only ones who can catch extremely rare types of fish.
job.fact_hacker: Hackers can automatically find the location of a mine in the Minesweeper game.
job.fact_streamer: Streamers can go viral, multiplying their work earnings by 5x!
job.fact_chef: Chefs are respected by the Dealer, earning tips even on a Blackjack Push.
job.fact_musician: Musicians can reach a Flow State, doubling their luck in gambling games.
job.fact_soldier: Elite soldiers always receive fixed stipends after each mission deployment.
job.fact_trader: Traders have sharp market intuition, ensuring they always get bonuses when searching.
job.fact_teacher: Teachers help everyone around them learn more effectively and earn more coins.

guides.trivia:
🌟 **Description:** Challenge your knowledge with a huge question bank covering Science, History, Entertainment, and more!

🕹️ **How to Play:**
1. Use the command to receive a multiple-choice question.
2. You have **15 seconds** to analyze and answer.
3. Click the button (A, B, C, D) corresponding to the correct answer.

✨ **Teacher Perk:** **Tutoring** — Correct answers grant a **+50% coin bonus** and extra XP for you!

💰 **Rewards:** Correct answers earn coins instantly. If no one answers, the coins remain in the bank!
guides.hangman:
🌟 **Description:** A classic word-guessing game where you must find the hidden word before the man is fully drawn!

🕹️ **How to Play:**
- The bot selects a random mystery word.
- You start with **6 lives** (❤️).
- Message a single letter to guess (e.g., "a").
- If the letter is in the word, it reveals all its positions.
- If not, you lose 1 life.
- You can also type the full word if you're confident.

💡 **Tip:** Use the hint button for a dictionary definition, but use it sparingly!

💰 **Rewards:** Winning gives you **50 coins** plus a bonus for remaining lives.
guides.scramble:
🌟 **Description:** Put your vocabulary to the test! Unscramble the jumbled letters to find the hidden word.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
- A scrambled word appears (e.g., "elppa" -> "apple").
- You have **30 seconds** to type the correct unscrambled word in the chat.

✨ **Programmer Perk:** **Regex Assist** — Automatically reveals an extra hint letter to help you solve it faster.

💰 **Rewards:** The first person to solve it correctly receives **50 coins**.
guides.connect4:
🌟 **Description:** A strategic 1v1 battle! Be the first to line up four pieces of your color vertically, horizontally, or diagonally.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
1. Challenge: `$connect4 @user [bet]` (betting is optional).
2. Opponent must click 'Accept' to start.
3. Players take turns clicking columns (1-7) to drop their piece (🔴 or 🟡).

⚖️ **Rules:**
- Gravity applies: pieces fall to the lowest available spot in a column.
- The game ends in a draw if the entire board (42 slots) is filled without a winner.

💰 **Rewards:** The winner takes 100% of the pot (minus a small house fee).
guides.memory:
🌟 **Description:** Train your brain! Find all matching pairs of emojis hidden behind buttons.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
1. A 4x4 grid of face-down icons appears.
2. Click a button to flip it and reveal the emoji.
3. Click another button to find its match.
4. If they match, they stay revealed. If not, they flip back after a second.

🎯 **Goal:** Match all **8 pairs** with the fewest attempts possible.

💰 **Rewards:**
- Base Completion: **100 coins**.
- Speed Bonus: Bonus coins if you finish in under 30 or 60 seconds.
guides.minesweeper:
🌟 **Description:** A high-stakes gambling version of the classic! Navigate the minefield to multiply your winnings.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
- The 5x5 grid contains **5 hidden mines**.
- Click ⬜ buttons to reveal what's underneath.
- **Gem (💎):** Increases your win multiplier. Safe to continue!
- **Mine (💣):** Game over. You lose your entire current bet.
- **Cashout:** Click the Cashout button at any time to walk away with your accumulated winnings.

🛡️ **Defense:** If you have a **Shield** in your inventory, it will automatically break to save 50% of your bet when you hit a mine.

💰 **Limit:** The more gems you find, the higher the risk... and the higher the reward!
guides.wordchain:
🌟 **Description:** A competitive multi-player linguistic challenge. How long can the chain go?

🕹️ **How to Play:**
1. Bot starts with a random word.
2. You must type a word that **starts with the last letter** of the previous word.
3. Example: `Apple` -> `Elephant` -> `Tiger`.

⚖️ **Strict Rules:**
- Words must be valid English (verified via dictionary).
- You cannot follow your own word (no solo play).
- Words cannot be reused during the same session.

💰 **Rewards:** Every valid word added to the chain earns you coins!
guides.blackjack:
🌟 **Description:** Beat the dealer by getting closer to 21 without going over.

🕹️ **Card Values:**
- 2-10: Face value. | J, Q, K: 10 points. | Ace: 1 or 11 points (dynamic).

✨ **Job Synergies:**
- **Chef**: Receives a **Complimentary Drink** tip (50-100 coins) on a Push.
- **Musician**: 15% chance for **Flow State** (Double final win).
- **Trader**: 25% chance for **Market Insight** (Refund 50% of bet on loss).

💰 **Payouts:**
- Win: **2x** | Natural (A+10): **2.5x** | Push: Refund.
guides.slots:
🌟 **Description:** Pull the lever and test your luck on the high-fidelity 3-reel slot machine.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
- Enter your bet and type the command.
- Match three symbols in the middle horizontal row to win.

✨ **Streamer Perk:** **Sub Hype** — 10% chance to double any win payout!

💰 **Paytable:**
- 7️⃣7️⃣7️⃣ (Triple Sevens): **x100 JACKPOT!**
- 💎💎💎 (Diamonds): **x50**
- ⭐⭐⭐ (Stars): **x25**
- 🍒🍒🍒 (Cherries): **x10**
- Two matching symbols (any): **50% Refund**.

✨ **Trader Perk:** **Market Manipulation** — Traders have slightly improved odds of winning common symbols!
guides.poker:
🌟 **Description:** Texas Hold'em Poker! Outsmart and outbet your opponents in this classic card game.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
1. Lobby: Create a game and wait for at least 2 players to join.
2. Deal: Each player gets 2 private cards (Hole cards).
3. Betting: 4 rounds are played (Pre-flop, Flop, Turn, River).
4. Actions: **Fold** (Quit), **Check/Call** (Match bet), **Raise** (Increase bet), **All-in** (Bet everything).

⚖️ **Winning:** The best 5-card hand made using hole cards and 5 community cards wins the entire pot.

💡 **Hand Rankings:** Royal Flush > Straight Flush > 4-of-a-Kind > Full House > Flush > Straight > 3-of-a-Kind > 2 Pair > Pair > High Card.
guides.emojiquiz:
🌟 **Description:** A fun visual puzzle! Guess the common phrase, movie, or object described by a set of emojis.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
- Analyze the emoji string (e.g., 🍎🥧 -> Apple Pie).
- You have **30 seconds** to type the exact answer.

✨ **Teacher Perk:** **Tutoring** — Correct answers grant a **+50% coin bonus** and extra XP!

💰 **Rewards:** Fast and correct answers provide a coin reward based on difficulty.
guides.guess:
🌟 **Description:** A simple but addictive numbers game. Can you find the number I'm thinking of?

🕹️ **How to Play:**
- Bot picks a random number between **1 and 100**.
- You have **10 attempts** to guess it.
- After each guess, the bot tells you if the number is **higher** (🔼) or **lower** (🔽).

💰 **Rewards:** The reward starts high and decreases with every failed attempt. Guess fast for maximum profit!
guides.rps:
🌟 **Description:** Rock, Paper, Scissors! A classic game of prediction available in Solo or PvP mode.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
- Choose your weapon: 🪨 Rock, 📄 Paper, or ✂️ Scissors.
- **Solo:** Play against the bot for a bet.
- **PvP:** Challenge another user to a high-stakes duel.

⚖️ **Counters:** Rock beats Scissors, Scissors beats Paper, Paper beats Rock.
guides.tictactoe:
🌟 **Description:** The timeless 3x3 strategy game. Get three in a row to win.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
1. Challenge another user: `$ttt @user [bet]`.
2. Take turns placing your mark (❌ or ⭕).

💰 **Outcome:** Winner takes the pot. Refund on draw.
guides.fish:
🌟 **Description:** Relax and cast your line! Catch anything from tiny minnows to legendary sea monsters.

🎣 **Gear:**
- **Rod:** Buy Bamboo, Fiberglass, or Carbon rods in `$shop`.
- **Bait:** Buy worms, crickets, or squid to attract different fish.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
- Simply use the `$fish` command. The bot automatically uses your best gear.
- Each trip consumes 1 bait and has a short cooldown.

✨ **Luck Factor:** Better gear increases your 'Luck' stat, making it easier to catch rare fish (Sharks, Kraken) with massive values!
guides.crate:
🌟 **Description:** The ultimate gacha system! Seek out incredibly rare and powerful items hidden inside various types of crates.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$crate list`: View the crates you currently own.
- `$crate open <ID> [quantity]`: Open your crates (e.g., `$crate open 805 10`).

💰 **Rewards:**
- Coins, consumable items, and high-tier cosmetic/buff items.
- Higher-tier crates (Legendary, Mythical) contain much more valuable rewards!
guides.marry:
🌟 **Description:** Marry the one you love and build a life together.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
1. Propose using the `$marry @user` command.
2. You must have a **Wedding Ring** or **Diamond Ring** in your inventory.
3. If they accept, you will be officially married.

💰 **Rewards (Permanent Buff):**
- **Wedding Ring:** +25% income for both spouses.
- **Diamond Ring:** +50% income for both spouses.

⚠️ **Note:** This bonus is lost if you divorce.
guides.divorce:
🌟 **Description:** End your current marriage relationship.

🕹️ **Usage:** `$divorce`

⚠️ **Consequences:**
- The relationship status is cleared from your profile.
- Both partners will **immediately lose all income buffs** from this marriage.
- This action cannot be undone!
guides.gift:
🌟 **Description:** Send items from your inventory to other players.

🕹️ **Usage:** `$gift @user <amount> <item_name>`

✨ **Romantic Combo:**
- Gifting a **Wedding Bouquet** to your spouse triggers a **+25% income buff** for them for 2 hours.
- A small gesture that brings great rewards! 💖
guides.work:
🌟 **Description:** Build your career and earn a steady income.

🕹️ **Mechanics:**
- Work every hour to gain **XP** and **Coins**.
- High-tier jobs (Doctor, CEO...) require a higher Level to unlock.

💼 **Job Bonuses:**
- **Police**: 15% chance for **Overtime pay** (+150 flat bonus).
- **Soldier**: Guaranteed **Mission Leader** bonus (+150 coins).
- **Programmer**: Professional focus grants a flat **+200 bonus** income.

💰 **Daily Streak:** Working consistently increases your streak, providing daily bonus coins.
guides.crime:
🌟 **Description:** Execute illegal heists for fast cash.

⚠️ **Risks:**
- Success rate is only 40%.
- If you fail, you'll be fined **10% of your total balance**.

💰 **Rewards:** Massive payouts and much more XP than `$work`.
guides.beg:
🌟 **Description:** Try your luck by begging strangers for money.

💰 **Rewards:** Very small payouts, but low risk.
guides.search:
🌟 **Description:** Scavenge random locations for dropped coins.

💰 **Rewards:** Moderate income, usually found in trash cans or under sofa cushions.
guides.rob:
🌟 **Description:** Break in and steal coins from another user.

⚠️ **Risks:**
- If you fail, you'll pay a 20% fine of your balance to the victim.

💰 **Rewards:** Steal a portion of someone else's wealth.
guides.slut:
🌟 **Description:** Go out and earn extra income through 'side' services.

⚠️ **Risks:**
- Success rate is 60%.
- If you fail, you'll pay a fixed medical fee.

💰 **Rewards:** Moderate payouts, balancing risk and profit.
guides.profile:
🌟 **Description:** Your comprehensive digital passport. Showcase your status, wealth, and ranking progress in the Bot's world.

- Shows Level, XP, Job, and Marriage status.
- Tracks Wallet balance and total Net Worth.

guides.balance:
🌟 **Description:** Check your own or another user's coin balance.

🕹️ **Usage:**

guides.daily:
🌟 **Description:** Claim your free daily coin reward every 24 hours.

✨ **Special Events:**
- **Chef**: **Michelin Star** (Chance to triple the daily reward!).
- **Doctor**: **Medical Trial** (Chance for +100-300 bonus coins).
- **Streamer**: **Subathon** (Chance for +25% total bonus).

💡 **Tip:** Maintain a daily streak to increase your rewards!
guides.buyrole:

💡 **Tip:** View available roles using `$roleshop`.
guides.lottery:

🕹️ **Usage:**

guides.setdistchannel:

guides.job:

⚙️ **Sub-commands:**
- `$job list`: View all available jobs and their perks.
- `$job info`: View detailed info about your current job.

💼 **Note:** Use a 'Career Change Voucher' to switch paths.
guides.house:
🌟 **Description:** Buy a home and decorate it with luxurious interiors to gain permanent income and luck buffs.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
- `$house buy <ID>`: Purchase a new house tier (e.g., Apartment, Villa).
- `$house decorate <ID>`: Buy furniture and interiors (e.g., Designer Bed, Gaming Setup) to boost your stats.
- `$house info`: View your current residence and active house buffs.

✨ **Rewards:**
- **Income Multipliers**: Specialized furniture increases your earnings from work and crimes.
- **Luck Stats**: High-end houses boost your luck in fishing and crates!

💡 **Tip:** Higher-tier houses are required to unlock the most powerful furniture and expensive decorations.
guides.business:
🌟 **Description:** Build your financial empire! Own and manage multiple businesses to generate massive passive income.

🕹️ **How to Play:**
- `$business buy <ID>`: Invest in a new business (e.g., Cafe, Tech Startup, Airport).
- `$business info`: Check your business levels, staff count, and current hourly earnings.
- `$business collect`: Harvest the accumulated profits from all your businesses.
- `$business upgrade <ID>`: Invest coins to increase business levels and staff for higher output.

📈 **Passive Income:**
- Your businesses generate coins every hour even while you are offline!

💡 **Tip:** Remember to use the `$collect` command regularly to add your profits to your wallet!
guides.inventory:
🌟 **Description:** Your personal storage. Keep track of all the assets, tools, and precious items you've collected.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$inventory` or `$inv`: View your own bag.
- `$inventory @user`: View another user's inventory.

💡 **Tip:** Use the category buttons below to filter items by function (Tools, Buffs, Other).
guides.buy:
🌟 **Description:** Trade items. Buy new gear to boost your income or sell unused items to recover coins.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$buy <ID/Name> [quantity]`: Purchase items from the Shop.

💡 **Tip:** Check item IDs in `$shop`.
guides.sell:
🌟 **Description:** Sell items from your inventory to recover coins.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$sell <ID/Name> [quantity]`: Sell items in your bag.

⚖️ **Refund:** Receive **70%** of the original purchase price.
guides.iteminfo:
🌟 **Description:** The item encyclopedia. Provides detailed stats, buff effects, and the best-suited jobs for each item.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$iteminfo <ID/Name>`: View details for a specific item.

💡 **Tip:** Some items reach their full potential when used by the correct profession (e.g., Laptop for Hackers).
guides.use:
🌟 **Description:** Use an item from your inventory to activate its buff or effect.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$use <item_id>`
guides.transfer:
🌟 **Description:** Secure money transfer. Share your wealth with friends or pay for personal transactions.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$transfer @user <amount>`: Transfer coins directly to another user's wallet.

⚠️ **Note:** There are no transfer fees, but always double-check the recipient's name!
guides.coinflip:
🌟 **Description:** Instant luck challenges with a coin!

🕹️ **Usage:** `$cf <amount> <heads|tails>`

💰 **Payout:** Winners receive **x2** the bet amount (minus a 5% house fee).
guides.dice:
🌟 **Description:** Instant luck challenges with dice!

🕹️ **Usage:** `$dice <amount> <1-6>`

💰 **Payout:** Winners receive **x2** the bet amount (minus a 5% house fee).
guides.rank:
🌟 **Description:** The Hall of Fame. Track your position compared to other players in terms of experience and dedication.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$rank`: View the top 10 players with the highest XP.

💡 **Tip:** Stay active and work hard to climb the rankings!
guides.lvl:
🌟 **Description:** View your personal level card with a stylish XP progress bar.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$lvl [@user]`
guides.jobdetail:
🌟 **Description:** Profession profiles. Discover the promotion milestones, salaries, and perks of every job in the system.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$jobdetail <ID/JobName>`: View details for a specific job.

💡 **Tip:** Reach Level 20 to unlock the profession system and enjoy unique perks!
guides.shop:
🌟 **Description:** A bustling marketplace! The place to upgrade your gear and purchase essential support items.

🕹️ **Usage:**
- `$shop [page]`: View the list of items for sale.
- `$shop <income|daily|gamble|tools|social>`: View specific categories.
